tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background behind everything: app shell, sidebar gutter, blocked-tab overlay.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, tab bar and top bars. The default ground for text.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, bottom sheets, popovers and the mini-player: anything floating above a card. Pair with a shadow token.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Gauge and progress tracks, segmented-control wells, code and pairing-code boxes. Never put body text on it at less than 13px.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, ghost buttons and nav items.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders (1px). Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders that must be seen: inputs, unchecked checkboxes, toggle tracks when off, secondary buttons in light mode. At least 3:1 on bg and surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: explanations, reasons on directive cards, helper text. On bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: timestamps, axis ticks, captions, inactive tab labels. Still 4.5:1 on bg, surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse (chart tooltips, the VS Code hover).

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Chart tooltips only. A small, high-contrast flag that floats over data.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand periwinkle. Primary buttons, active nav, links, the selected task outline, focus-mode progress. As text on bg, surface and accent-soft.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for primary buttons.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent icons and text: active nav item, directive icon tiles, the recommended task row.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Label and icon colour on an accent fill. Dark ink in dark mode, white in light mode: never hard-code white.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px. Solid, at least 3:1 on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: ctx-deep-focus
tokens.usage: Deep focus: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-deep-focus-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-deep-focus-chart
tokens.usage: Deep focus as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-deep-focus-soft
tokens.usage: Deep focus tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: ctx-shallow-work
tokens.usage: Shallow work: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-shallow-work-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-shallow-work-chart
tokens.usage: Shallow work as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-shallow-work-soft
tokens.usage: Shallow work tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: ctx-stuck
tokens.usage: Stuck: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-stuck-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-stuck-chart
tokens.usage: Stuck as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-stuck-soft
tokens.usage: Stuck tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: ctx-fatigue
tokens.usage: Fatigue: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-fatigue-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-fatigue-chart
tokens.usage: Fatigue as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-fatigue-soft
tokens.usage: Fatigue tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: ctx-recovering
tokens.usage: Recovering: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-recovering-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-recovering-chart
tokens.usage: Recovering as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-recovering-soft
tokens.usage: Recovering tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: ctx-unknown
tokens.usage: Warming up: identity colour for the gauge arc, context icon and pill label. Text-safe (4.5:1) on surface, surface-raised and ctx-unknown-soft.

tokens.name: ctx-unknown-chart
tokens.usage: Warming up as a chart series: timeline segments, stacked bars, the context distribution bar. Validated as one categorical set (CVD-safe in fixed order: deep focus, shallow work, stuck, fatigue, recovering). Place series on surface, never on surface-sunken (light shallow-work falls to 2.6:1 there). Never text.

tokens.name: ctx-unknown-soft
tokens.usage: Warming up tinted ground: pill background, toast icon disc, filter chip when selected.

tokens.name: load-intrinsic
tokens.usage: Intrinsic load (task difficulty) bar and series. A chart colour, never text.

tokens.name: load-extraneous
tokens.usage: Extraneous load (distraction and switching) bar and series. A chart colour, never text.

tokens.name: load-germane
tokens.usage: Germane load (productive effort) bar and series. A chart colour, never text.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Live connection, connected sources, success confirmations. Always with a word or icon. Text-safe on surface and positive-soft.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind positive text and the Live badge.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: Reconnecting, low confidence notices, unsaved changes. Text-safe on surface and caution-soft.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for caution banners.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Destructive actions (delete my data) and form errors only. Never for load, fatigue or stuck. Text-safe on surface and critical-soft.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error banners and the danger zone in Settings.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Label on a critical fill (the danger button).

tokens.name: rest-surface
tokens.usage: Break screens: the whole canvas turns to this calm ground so a break never looks like work.

tokens.name: rest-surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards and the breathing disc on a break screen.

tokens.name: rest-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and the timer track on a break screen.

tokens.name: rest-ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on rest-surface and rest-surface-raised.

tokens.name: rest-ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on rest-surface.

tokens.name: rest-accent
tokens.usage: Break timer arc, break buttons and icons on rest-surface. Text-safe there.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines (1px). Recessive by design.

tokens.name: chart-threshold
tokens.usage: Dashed reference lines for the high-load and fatigue thresholds, and the gauge threshold ticks.

tokens.name: heat-0
tokens.usage: Heatmap: no focus that hour.

tokens.name: heat-1
tokens.usage: Heatmap: a little focus (under 10 min).

tokens.name: heat-2
tokens.usage: Heatmap: some focus (10 to 25 min).

tokens.name: heat-3
tokens.usage: Heatmap: solid focus (25 to 45 min).

tokens.name: heat-4
tokens.usage: Heatmap: your best hours (45 min or more).

tokens.name: skeleton
tokens.usage: Skeleton block fill while data loads.

tokens.name: skeleton-shine
tokens.usage: The moving highlight on a skeleton (static when reduced motion is on).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind bottom sheets, dialogs and the blocked-tab card. Solid colour, no backdrop blur (WebView performance).

styles.name: num-gauge
styles.usage: The load number inside the hero gauge (desktop 280px gauge). 56px on mobile. Always tabular numerals.

styles.name: num-timer
styles.usage: Pomodoro and focus countdown. 56px on mobile. Tabular numerals so digits never shift.

styles.name: num-inline
styles.usage: Percentages in breakdown rows, durations in task rows, playback time.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Page title in the desktop top bar; auth and onboarding headings.

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Mobile top-bar title, hero context name, sheet titles.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles, empty-state titles, toast titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Little switching, steady effort. This is your flow zone.
styles.usage: Hero explanations, onboarding copy, break-screen prompts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Notifications silenced: protecting your deep-focus window.
styles.usage: Default UI text. 16px minimum inside inputs on mobile (prevents zoom).

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: How hard the task itself is.
styles.usage: Reasons, helper text, breakdown explanations, table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, nav items, field labels, chips.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Timestamps, axis ticks, tab-bar labels (12px is the floor).

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Section eyebrows above card groups. Set text-transform: uppercase in CSS; never use for sentences.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Pairing codes on source cards and the VS Code status-bar text spec.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside chips and pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its text; between stacked label and value.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between list rows and between chips.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; mobile page gutter; gap between cards on mobile.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Grid gutter on desktop and tablet; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Desktop page padding (top and sides); space between page sections.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space above a page title; onboarding step padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Auth and onboarding panel padding on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Chips, tags, heatmap cells, small badges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs inside dense tables, segmented-control options, tooltip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, directive icon tiles, task rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, toasts, the mini-player.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom-sheet top corners, the extension popup, the blocked-tab card.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Pills, toggles, avatars, the play button, status dots.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Selected segmented option, slider thumb, toggle thumb.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Toasts, menus, the mini-player.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs, the blocked-tab card.

duration.note: Motion durations. Under prefers-reduced-motion every one of these becomes 1ms except dur-gauge, which drops to 0 (values jump) and the breathing animation, which stops.

tokens.name: dur-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback, toggle thumb colour.

tokens.name: dur-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills, focus ring, chip selection.

tokens.name: dur-base
tokens.usage: Toasts in and out, sheet content fade, banner swap.

tokens.name: dur-slow
tokens.usage: Context colour crossfade, task reorder (FLIP), sheet slide.

tokens.name: dur-gauge
tokens.usage: Gauge arc and number tween. Shorter than the 2s update interval, so each tick settles before the next.

tokens.name: dur-breath
tokens.usage: One full breathing cycle on break screens (4s in, 4s out).

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Most UI transitions.

tokens.name: ease-out
tokens.usage: Gauge, number tweens and entering elements: fast start, soft landing.

tokens.name: ease-in-out
tokens.usage: Breathing disc and reorder moves.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Desktop sidebar (1024px and up). Collapses to a 72px icon rail at 1024 to 1279px.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Icon-only sidebar on small desktops and tablets in landscape.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: Desktop top bar.

tokens.name: mobile-topbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile top bar under the Android status bar.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom tab bar, plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom).

tokens.name: miniplayer-height
tokens.usage: Persistent timer bar, docked 8px above the tab bar on mobile.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for anything tappable, even when the visual is smaller.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the main column on wide screens.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky table headers and the mobile top bar.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: Sidebar and tab bar.

tokens.name: z-miniplayer
tokens.usage: The persistent timer bar.

tokens.name: z-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets, dialogs and their scrim.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, always above sheets.
